ENR: En route (phase of flight between departure and arrival)
FAP: Final approach point (point where final approach begins)
FDPS: Flight data processing system (ATC data processor)
FIC: Flight information centre (provides FIS and ALRS)
FIR: Flight information region (airspace with defined boundaries)
FIS: Flight information service (weather and traffic advisory)
FLTCK: Flight check (aircraft or navaid inspection flight)
FMS: Flight management system (integrated navigation and flight planning)
FMU: Flow management unit (ATC traffic flow unit)
FPAP: Flight path alignment point (GBAS reference point)
FPR: Flight plan route (planned path of flight)
FSL: Full stop landing (complete stop after landing)
FSS: Flight service station (pilot briefing and advisory)
FTE: Flight technical error (deviation from intended path)
